review_type: Independent plan/script review with public unauthenticated GET verification; no mutation execution

operation.allowed_change: Append required_status_checks for metadata, focused-frontend, isolated-runtime, each integration_id15368; strict_required_status_checks_policy=true and do_not_enforce_on_create=true; preserve all prior policy fields. No other remote mutation.

checks.name: Exact snapshot and execution bytes
checks.method: Read SHA256 of both files; byte equality; ast.parse only. Mutation script was not imported or executed.

checks.name: Minimal ruleset change
checks.method: Parsed candidate equals plan candidate; all top-level prior mutable fields and ordered existing rules equal plan.before. required_reviewers=[] and require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_changes=true preserved.

checks.name: Repository/main/app identity
checks.method: Unauthenticated GET repository, main ref and codex/portable-foundation ref

checks.name: Live prior rules
checks.method: Unauthenticated GET ruleset27859157 confirms repository source, name, active branch target, conditions and all prior rule fields match plan.before; public API deliberately omits bypass_actors.

checks.name: CI merge checkout tree relationship
checks.method: Unauthenticated GET git/commits for expected app head and actual CI checkout

checks.name: Script mutation and preflight boundary
checks.method: Static source/AST read: one remote mutation call only, fixed PUT to owned ruleset; hardcoded repo ID/default branch; expected main/app refs; exact full prior policy; candidate equality/hash and prior-rule preservation; completed success for each exact Actions15368 context on expected-head endpoint. No ref, permission, workflow or runtime mutation.

checks.name: Readback and success boundary
checks.method: Static source: PASS receipt emitted only after exact mutable ruleset readback, main equality and active effective required_status_checks parameters. API errors/assertion failures interrupt before PASS emission. Existing applied receipt absent at review time.

checks.name: Credential/redirect exposure boundary
checks.method: Static source: token obtained only by executor from noninteractive git credential helper, used in Authorization header to fixed api.github.com origin; NoRedirect forbids forwarding credentials to another URL; no token printing or persistence in source. Reviewer did not retrieve credentials.

execution_conditions: Recheck plan, candidate and execution-script SHA256 against this receipt immediately before execution; any byte change requires renewed review.

Run from this control repository with normal non-optimized Python (__debug__ true, no -O/-OO and no PYTHONOPTIMIZE). Current read-only python -B -c probe reported optimize=0 and __debug__=True; script guards use assert.
Respect the script stale guards. A changed repo/ref/prior ruleset is a stop condition, not permission to refresh expected values without review.
Keep one ruleset operator during this bounded operation. There is no transactional compare-and-swap across preflight GET and PUT.
If PUT succeeds but readback fails, inspect live state read-only before deciding next action; failure does not imply rollback. Do not treat a stale or absent receipt as evidence of application.
Execution PASS proves only server configuration/readback. Actual blocked merge attempt, merge, release and product acceptance remain outside this clearance.

sources.read_sections: Get/update repository ruleset; required_status_checks parameters; get rules for a branch
sources.applied_criteria: Use fixed repository/ruleset PUT; retain current policy; bind contexts to integration; strict policy; verify active branch rules. Bypass actors are visible only to users with write access.
Cross-check same required-check schema; no Enterprise-only evaluate enforcement selected.

sources.read_sections: Unique job names; required check expected app source; strict versus loose checks
sources.applied_criteria: Observed names from real checks; source15368 selected; strict policy chosen. Source app binding does not establish workflow correctness.

sources.read_sections: List check runs for a Git reference; ref/filter/pagination
sources.applied_criteria: Query immutable expected-head SHA. Three returned entries all completed success from app15368. Empty merge-ref response is not interpreted as success.

limits: Mutation script execution, authenticated bypass-list verification, post-PUT effective-rule behavior and actual merge blocking: NOT_RUN by reviewer. No credentials retrieved and no remote/runtime mutation.
Public ruleset GET omits bypass_actors by design. Executor exact selected==plan.before guard must verify actual authenticated bypass_actors=[] and abort on change.
This is exact-byte review of uncommitted plan/script/candidate, not approval of any later edited version or all files at reviewed_control_commit.

Required checks bind GitHub Actions app15368, not a particular workflow identity. The currently observed checks were independently linked to foundation-ci.yml/run45082996742; future same-name workflow substitution is outside this one-time configuration claim.
Preflight is not atomic; app ref is checked before PUT, main is also checked after PUT, and script itself contains no ref mutation. Concurrent external writes remain possible.
Script does not independently validate its own hash or plan hash; the exact-byte executor precheck is required. Candidate equality/hash is enforced by script.

Single-page check/effective-rule reads are sufficient for current three check-runs/small ruleset and otherwise can fail closed on missing entries; this receipt does not certify a general reusable mutation tool.
All CI evidence is selected hosted-runner scope. No full app suite rerun, independent raw-log replay, runtime certification or human GitHub approval is claimed.
Agent has shared machine rights; fresh review context is not an OS or credential sandbox.
